metadata.protocol: Independent out/dQ/dK/dV versus FP64 mathematical and single-rounded-P/dS equations. Backward rounded reference uses actual O for delta. CUDA graph changed-input checks; rotate CuTe and default SDPA timing order. Device-event graph replay; compilation excluded.
metadata.precision_contract: Single rounded FP16/BF16 P; dS formed from rounded P and actual O/dO FP32 delta, rounded once; FP32 accumulation followed by gradient scaling.

controls.sdpa: Default PyTorch SDPA; actual graph symbols identify the selected kernels.
